triggers.filterCode: function(ctx, battle, self) { if (!ctx.sourcePiece || ctx.sourcePiece.instanceId !== self.ownerId) return false; return !!(ctx.damage && ctx.damage > 0); }
triggers.effectCode: function(ctx, battle, self) { var piece = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.instanceId === self.ownerId; }); if (!piece || piece.currentHp <= 0) return { success: false }; var healAmount = Math.ceil(ctx.damage * 0.5); if (healAmount <= 0) return { success: false }; var result = healDamage(piece, piece, healAmount, 'reap'); return { success: true, message: piece.name + '收割治疗了' + (result && result.heal || healAmount) + '点生命' }; }
